newsitem.title: UK: EBRD lends Russia's Gazprom $225 mln.
newsitem.headline: EBRD lends Russia's Gazprom $225 mln.

text.p: The European Bank for Reconstruction and Development said on Friday it would lend the Russian natural gas monopoly RAO Gazprom $225 million to upgrade its gas supply system.
Of the total, $125 million will be syndicated with commercial banks over four years. The other $100 million is for five years.

"Even though RAO Gazprom has recently gained wide access to the international loan and equity markets, the EBRD's loan is novel in the sense that it will be the first syndicated loan facility to Gazprom without recourse to its long-term export contracts or other guarantees," EBRD President Jacques de Larosiere said in a statement.
Under the terms of the loan, Gazprom will apply the EBRD's procurement policies and rules, further enhancing its competitive tendering practices, the bank said.
The proceeds will be used to finance investments to improve pipeline inspection, metering, introducing mobile compressor stations and replacing valves.
It will also finance feasibility studies to prepare for high priority reconstruction investment and to address environmental issues.
